pr.title: Expressions: Add notification for Strict Mode behavior in Reduce component
pr.body: **What is this feature?** This feature adds a notification to the Reduce component in Grafana when "Strict Mode" is selected. It informs users about the behavior of the fill(null) function in InfluxQL, which results in NaN. **Why do we need this feature?** Users unfamiliar with the behavior of "Strict Mode" may find the NaN result confusing when using fill(null). This notification provides clarity and directs users to the relevant documentation, improving the user experience. **Who is this feature for?** This feature is for Grafana users who use the Reduce component with "Strict Mode" enabled, especially those working with InfluxQL queries. **Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**: Fixes Fixes #79315 **Special notes for your reviewer:** Please check that: - [ ] It works as expected from a user's perspective. - [ ] If this is a pre-GA feature, it is behind a feaxture toggle. - [ ] The docs are updated, and if this is a [notable improvement](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/#how-to-determine-if-content-belongs-in-whats-new), it's added to our [What's New](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/contribute/release-notes/) doc.
